inputs.text: I just heard about this at JFK International Airport in New York on Thursday. An Immigration and Customs Enforcement agent jumped into action after a baby stuck in a crowded TSA line with his family stopped breathing. The Department of Homeland Security released video footage showing a man holding a baby notice something wrong with the child and begin to act. This is exactly the kind of decisive authority we need in a nation where families depend on order and protection. These agents stand for the duty and responsibility that keep society intact, even when lines get backed up and chaos threatens the vulnerable. It's a clear reminder why we should back our law enforcement and border institutions instead of letting progressive attacks erode the values that actually safeguard our children and way of life.
